text.lead: The Thorn in the Heart (French: L'épine dans le coeur) is a 2009 French documentary film directed by Michel Gondry. It was given a special screening at the 2009 Cannes Film Festival and was also screened at the Sheffield Doc/Fest.
text.plot: The film is a documentary look at the director's family at home in the Cévennes, particularly his aunt Suzette.
text.cast:
- Suzette Gondry as herself
- Jean-Yves Gondry as himself
- Michel Gondry as himself
